name: sentinel
description: Drop a URL, local path, or git repo and get a comprehensive, evidence-backed security report with exact file:line:CWE findings and concrete fixes. Real scanners find the bugs (semgrep, detect-secrets, dependency audits, web recon); the LLM only explains and prioritizes — it can never invent a finding.
author: AGNT

schema.title: Sentinel Scan
schema.description: Ingest a target (git URL, local directory path, or live http(s) URL) and run every applicable security scanner. Returns normalized, deduplicated, evidence-backed findings with file:line:CWE. Does NOT call an LLM — this is the deterministic ground-truth stage.

target.description: What to scan: a git URL (https://github.com/user/repo), an absolute local directory path, or a live URL (https://example.com).

depth.description: Scan depth. 'standard' runs the core scanners; 'deep' adds git-history secret sweep and extended semgrep rulesets.

webActiveProbe.description: For live-URL targets only: probe for exposed sensitive files (.git, .env, backups). Non-destructive GETs only. Requires you own or are authorized to test the target.

summary.description: Counts by severity, risk score, scanners run, target metadata.

totalFindings.description: Total number of findings (full set is on disk at findingsPath).

findings.description: Context-safe slice: the top (highest-severity) findings only. Read findingsPath for the complete set.

truncated.description: True when more findings exist than are returned inline.

findingsPath.description: Absolute path to the JSON file holding the complete findings array + summary.

target.description: Resolved target info: kind (git|local|url), path/url, languages detected.

error.description: Error message if the scan failed.

schema.title: Sentinel Report
schema.description: Turn Sentinel findings into a comprehensive, plain-English security report (HTML + Markdown) with an executive summary, per-finding impact and concrete fix. The LLM works ONLY from verified findings — it never invents vulnerabilities.

findings.description: Findings array from sentinel-scan (or the full scan output object). Usually wired from the previous node. Optional if findingsPath is provided.

findingsPath.description: Absolute path to a findings JSON file written by sentinel-scan/sentinel-audit. Preferred over inline findings for large scans. Wire this from the scan node's findingsPath output.

summary.description: Summary object from sentinel-scan (optional; improves the report header).

provider.description: LLM backbone for the write-up. 'claude-code' uses your keyless Claude Code CLI. 'openrouter'/'openai'/'anthropic' use configured keys. 'none' emits a template report with no LLM prose.

reportPath.description: Absolute path to the saved standalone HTML report file.

markdownPath.description: Absolute path to the saved Markdown report file.

narrativeExcerpt.description: Short excerpt of the LLM executive summary (full prose is in the report files).

narrativeProvider.description: Which LLM backbone produced the prose.

totalFindings.description: Number of findings the report covers.

schema.title: Sentinel Audit (Scan + Report)
schema.description: One-shot: scan a target AND generate the full report. This is the node the simple frontend calls. Drop a URL/path/repo, get findings + an HTML report file back.

target.description: Git URL, absolute local directory path, or live URL to audit.

provider.description: LLM backbone for the report write-up.

totalFindings.description: Total number of findings (full set on disk at findingsPath).

findings.description: Context-safe slice of the top findings. Read findingsPath for the complete set.

truncated.description: True when more findings exist than are returned inline.

findingsPath.description: Absolute path to the complete findings JSON.

reportPath.description: Absolute path to the saved HTML report.

markdownPath.description: Absolute path to the saved Markdown report.

narrativeExcerpt.description: Short excerpt of the LLM executive summary.
